name: AsyncAPI 3.0
registry_consequence: Async channel, operation and message contracts can be versioned separately from broker products.

name: Canonical ABI lift/lower
registry_consequence: Canonical lifting and lowering makes memory, encoding, ownership and cleanup boundary decisions inspectable.

name: cargo-auditable
registry_consequence: Embedding dependency metadata in binaries improves post-build attribution.

name: cargo-cyclonedx
registry_consequence: Cargo graphs can be exported as standardized SBOMs.

name: cargo-semver-checks
registry_consequence: Deterministic API-diff lints add evidence to, but do not replace, semantic compatibility review.

name: cargo-vet
registry_consequence: Distributed dependency audits allow review evidence to follow exact dependency versions.

name: CloudEvents 1.0.2
registry_consequence: A small event envelope standardizes occurrence metadata without owning domain payload meaning.

name: Component Model async ABI work
registry_consequence: Language-neutral tasks, streams, futures, backpressure and cancellation are modeled together.

name: WebAssembly Component Model
registry_consequence: Typed cross-language components separate interface contracts from core modules and hosts.

name: Component plus Strategy
registry_consequence: Replaceable components and configurable strategies generalize ports and adapters beyond a fixed application hexagon.

name: CycloneDX 1.7
registry_consequence: A lifecycle-aware BOM object model describes components, services, dependencies and attestations.

name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022
registry_consequence: Architecture descriptions distinguish the entity from views, model kinds and conformance claims.

name: OpenAPI 3.1.1
registry_consequence: A language-neutral API description aligned with JSON Schema supports typed transport contracts while preserving semantic separation.

name: OpenSSF Scorecard
registry_consequence: Automated repository security signals create scoped evidence without claiming semantic conformance.

name: OSV schema
registry_consequence: Version-precise open vulnerability records support deterministic affected-range matching.

name: OpenTelemetry stable telemetry signals
registry_consequence: Portable trace, metric and log structures make runtime receipts less provider-specific.

name: Rust 2024 unsafe operation scoping
registry_consequence: Unsafe operations inside unsafe functions require explicit unsafe blocks, improving audit locality.

name: MSRV-aware Cargo resolution
registry_consequence: Dependency selection can consider rust-version instead of treating MSRV as prose only.

name: Secure Supply Chain Consumption Framework
registry_consequence: Dependency intake, inventory, update and incident processes are treated as a consumption lifecycle.

name: Sigstore keyless signing ecosystem
registry_consequence: Identity-bound signatures and transparency logs reduce reliance on long-lived signing keys.

name: SLSA 1.0
registry_consequence: Approved build provenance levels turned supply-chain assurances into verifiable producer and platform claims.

name: SLSA 1.2 Source Track
registry_consequence: Source history, review and source provenance become separately attestable from builds.

name: SPDX 3.0
registry_consequence: A profile-oriented BOM model covers builds, security, data and provenance beyond package lists.

name: WASI Preview 2
registry_consequence: Capability-oriented host interfaces make target requirements explicit.

name: WIT interface language
registry_consequence: A language-neutral interface contract can generate bindings without making generated code the semantic owner.
